decisions.reason: The current independent school-district trial explicitly identifies TWO initial READS trials, Kim2006 and Kim/White2008, as the experiments it attempts to replicate. The only shipped counterpart is Kim/White2008. Current Introduction separately describes Kim2006 treatment/comparison and printed bibliography identifies its distinct single-author paper; independent original publisher/author-institution abstract confirms552students/10schools versus400children in the2008trial. Thus Kim2006is genuinely absent. The new literal passage establishes actual retesting/identity, not an outcome from control-group summer loss. Earlier failed outcome is withheld: overall full-sample failure and exploratory poverty-heterogeneity evidence must not be mistaken for an original-specific conclusion derived from the quoted control arm. Retain the validated native identity-only unknown outcome; no blanket success/failure is forced.

The current paper explicitly attributes the18–24month Western mark-test benchmark to Nielsen/Dissanayake/Kashima2003 and tests that specific benchmark in newly observed cultural samples. NEW complete original author-hosted paper independently confirms all three authors, exact longitudinal self-other/MSR title,98infants observed9–24months, sticker mark testing and mean/median/modal onset18months. This is substantive original benchmark data, not merely a theoretical self-concept citation. It is absent from all shipped counterparts. Current Methods names a DIFFERENT two-author Nielsen/Dissanayake2003report; no claim that this is a citation to the three-author original is retained. New original evidence corroborates the benchmark independently, answering that earlier source objection without another unchanged model call. Identity is confirmed; original-specific cross-cultural outcome remains undetermined rather than carrying forward an unsupported mixed label.
